kp_title: Identifying Possible Pairs of First-Order Partial Derivatives
raw_html:
2.Identifying Possible Pairs of First-Order Partial Derivatives?

Suppose that the function f(x,y) and all of its first and second-order partial derivatives are continuous on an open set U. Which of the following pairs could represent the first-order partial derivatives of f(x,y)?

  1. fx(x,y)=4x+y2 and fy(x,y)=4xy−y
  2. fx(x,y)=2x+y and fy(x,y)=x+y
  3. fx(x,y)=2xy+y2 and fy(x,y)=x2y+2x
